 39. On perusal of the evidence of PW22, M. A. Humid, 1st Investigating Officer of the case, it appears that having heard the occurrence by the people, he made a G.D. Entry being No.70 dated 03.06.1990 and thereafter, he along with his companion forces rushed to the place of occurrence. In cross-examination, PW22 admits that he did not send or produce the said G.D. Entry to the Court. In point of time, the said G.D. Entry was made prior for the First Information Report (FIR). Non production of the said G.D. Entry before the Court raises strong presumption against the prosecution under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act.
